t: You're on Rosary Gardens, a street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. This is where Katharine Stephen lived, and where she died in 1924. She was a British librarian who went on to become principal of Newnham College at Cambridge University. So a street of ordinary homes here has a link to the world of women's higher education. I don't have more detail on her life on this street, but it's worth knowing a notable academic leader called it home.
